I wrote `component.html` in the billing/3 folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It has the "Billing" heading, the Team plan panel with a "Change Plan" button, and the Invoices table with the four rows. All of it sits inside `#component` at 1280px, in plain HTML and CSS.

I applied `DESIGN.md` throughout, using only its colors, type sizes, spacing, radii and letter-spacing. The only accent is a blue bar showing 18 of 25 seats used.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't be loaded here because the folder has no font files, so the page falls back to system fonts unless the viewer has them installed.
- **Headings:** I set "Team plan" and "Invoices" at 28px, the card-heading size, rather than the 46px section-heading size. Next to a 56px page title, 46px gave too little contrast in hierarchy.
- **Other files:** `session.json` is empty and `session.err` only logs an unrecognized-model warning, so neither added any instructions.
